notes: KZ (Kreedz climbing) build: players race timed obstacle courses, so this server deliberately turns OFF everything CS does to structure a round — no forced respawn, no freezetime, no buying, no team balance, mp_round_infinite 1. Do NOT copy the DM cvars from cs16-dm here; they fight the mode. Stack is Metamod 1.21.1-am + AMX Mod X 1.10.0.5479 + ReGameDLL + ReAPI + AmxxEasyHttp (ReAPI needs ReGameDLL only, NOT ReHLDS). THE TIMER IS INSTALLED: the Theggv/Kreedz suite is compiled from a pinned SHA during the image build, which fails rather than ship a half-built suite. Verified against the deployed server 2026-08-28 — 67 plugins on disk and zero setting themselves as failed. IT REQUIRES THE DATABASE, and not merely to persist: kz_core calls natives from kz_sql_core, so the MySQL sidecar is load-bearing for the timer itself. On a good boot it builds 19 tables in `kreedz`. Two ways that silently breaks, both fixed in the constructs and both worth recognising if they return — the game server must wait for the database to be HEALTHY (an AMXX plugin reads the database once, at plugin_cfg, and a plugin that cannot connect there marks itself failed for the life of the task), and the root account must exist for TCP (MARIADB_ROOT_HOST must be 127.0.0.1; 'localhost' matches only a socket login, and the resulting 'Access denied … (using password: YES)' reads as a wrong password rather than a missing account). In both cases the server looks perfectly healthy while the timer is gone. sv_airaccelerate IS NOT SERVER-OWNED HERE: the suite's uq_jumpstats plugin drives it from kz_uq_airaccelerate and re-asserts that value, so an rcon `sv_airaccelerate 100` reads back as 10 within a second. Set kz_uq_airaccelerate instead — the shim writes both. The plugin's own config is not shipped (the boot log says "couldn't exec addons/amxmodx/configs/uq_jumpstats/config.cfg"), so it otherwise falls back to 10, which is stock CS and makes most of these maps impossible. kz_invis is DEGRADED and expected to be: it hooks SV_StartSound, which needs ReHLDS, so its plugin_init throws a RegisterHookChain runtime error on every map load. The plugin still loads and nothing else is affected — same ReHLDS trap as ReSemiclip. Maps are 39 kreedz.com maps carrying that site's own difficulty tier, and mapcycles/ is generated from maps.txt ordered easiest-first; GAME_ENV_MAPCYCLE picks one (all | starter | climb | bhop | hard | tier-*), an env change rather than a rebuild. FastDL is required in practice: 224 MB against HLDS's 8 kB/s cap means a joiner without it times out.

commands.name: change_map
commands.description: Switch to a different map immediately.

commands.name: restart_round
commands.description: Restart the current round after a delay in seconds.

commands.name: kick_player
commands.description: Kick a player by name or userid (see server_status for ids).

commands.name: ban_player
commands.description: Ban a player by userid for N minutes (0 = permanent).

minutes.description: Ban length in minutes; 0 is permanent

userid.description: Numeric userid from the players query

commands.name: say
commands.description: Broadcast a message to everyone on the server.

commands.name: set_join_password
commands.description: Set or clear the password players need to join (empty clears it). Distinct from the rcon admin password.

password.description: Join password; empty string removes it

commands.name: amx_map
commands.description: Change level immediately via AMXX (bypasses any vote).

commands.name: force_vote
commands.description: Open a next-map vote between the maps you name (1-4). Does NOT read mapcycle.txt — amx_votemap takes its choices as arguments and prints usage if given none.

maps.description: One to four map names, space-separated, e.g. "de_dust2 de_aztec".

commands.name: show_nextmap
commands.description: Report the map queued next in the cycle.

commands.name: time_left
commands.description: Report time remaining on the current map.

commands.name: extend_map
commands.description: Add minutes to the current map's time limit.

commands.name: list_plugins
commands.description: List loaded AMXX plugins and whether each is running.

commands.name: meta_list
commands.description: List Metamod plugins — confirms AMXX was chain-loaded.

queries.name: players
queries.description: Who is connected: userid, name and steamid for each player, plus the current map. Use the userid with kick_player / ban_player.

cvars.name: mp_timelimit
cvars.description: Minutes per map before it changes. MUST NOT BE 0 here: AMXX then reads timeleft as 00:00 and the map vote never opens. GAME_ENV_TIMELIMIT sets it.

cvars.name: mp_startmoney
cvars.description: Money each player starts a match with.

cvars.name: bhop_auto
cvars.description: Auto re-jump while the jump key is held. Pair with bhop_speed — auto alone gives hops that never build velocity. ReGameDLL only. Not yet exercised against a running cs16-dm.

cvars.name: bhop_speed
cvars.description: Allow player speed to exceed the normal running cap — this is the actual bunnyhop. ReGameDLL only. Not yet exercised against a running cs16-dm.

cvars.name: jump_height
cvars.description: Player jump height (ReGameDLL default 45). Not yet exercised against a running cs16-dm.

cvars.name: airaccelerate
cvars.description: Mid-air steering — THE KZ cvar; every jump technique depends on it. 100 is the standard the maps and their published records assume; stock CS is 10, on which most KZ maps are impossible. Written to kz_uq_airaccelerate, NOT sv_airaccelerate: uq_jumpstats owns the engine cvar and overwrites a direct set within a second. Read back from sv_airaccelerate, which the plugin keeps in step.

cvars.name: gravity
cvars.description: Stock CS is 800. Changing it invalidates comparison against any published time.

cvars.name: maxspeed
cvars.description: Stock CS is 320. As with gravity, changing it makes times incomparable.
